nodes.summary: Let $H$ be a complex Hilbert space. A frame function on the projection lattice of $H$ is a function $\mu$ from the continuous linear operators on $H$ to $\mathbb{R}$ such that $\mu(P) \ge 0$ for every orthogonal projection $P$ on $H$, $\mu(P + Q) = \mu(P) + \mu(Q)$ for all orthogonal projections $P$ and $Q$ on $H$ with $PQ = 0$, and $\mu(I) = 1$ for the identity operator $I$ on $H$.
nodes.title: Frame function on projections

nodes.summary: Let $H$ be a finite-dimensional complex Hilbert space of dimension at least $3$, write $\operatorname{tr}$ for the trace of a $\mathbb{C}$-linear map on $H$, and let $\mu$ be a frame function on the projection lattice of $H$. Then there is a unique continuous linear operator $\rho$ on $H$ such that $\rho$ is positive, $\operatorname{Re} \operatorname{tr}(\rho) = 1$, and…
nodes.title: Gleason's theorem in finite dimensions

nodes.summary: Let $H$ be a separable complex Hilbert space whose dimension over $\mathbb{C}$ is at least $3$, and let $f$ be a frame function on the unit sphere of $H$. Then there is a positive continuous linear operator $\rho$ on $H$ such that $f(x) = \operatorname{Re} \langle x, \rho x \rangle$ for every unit vector $x$ in $H$.
nodes.title: Gleason's theorem for separable Hilbert spaces

nodes.summary: A continuous linear operator $P$ on a complex Hilbert space $H$ is an orthogonal projection if it is idempotent, $P^2 = P$, and self-adjoint, $P^* = P$.
nodes.title: Orthogonal projection

nodes.summary: For a continuous linear operator $A$ on a finite-dimensional complex Hilbert space $H$, let $\operatorname{tr}(A) \in \mathbb{C}$ be the trace of $A$ as a $\mathbb{C}$-linear map on $H$. The real part of the trace of $A$ is the real number $\operatorname{Re} \operatorname{tr}(A)$.
nodes.title: Real part of the trace

nodes.summary: Let $H$ be a complex Hilbert space. A frame function on the unit sphere of $H$ is a function $f$ from the unit vectors of $H$ to $\mathbb{R}$ such that $f(x) \ge 0$ for every unit vector $x$ in $H$ and, for every Hilbert basis $(b_i)_{i \in \iota}$ of $H$, the family $(f(b_i))_{i \in \iota}$ is unconditionally summable with sum $1$.
nodes.title: Frame function on the unit sphere

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
